description: Normalization and comparison rules this implementation applies when narrowing a capability grant against a bound (ODIS-L2-06). Comparison is structural over typed rules; no scope strings are normalized or compared.

comparison_axes.rule: A family absent from the bound is dropped. The bound never adds a family the grant does not request.
A verb is kept only when both the grant requests it and the bound permits it. At most one rule per verb per spec.
An empty allow-list means unrestricted and never narrows the other side. Two non-empty lists intersect. A verb whose two non-empty lists share no field is dropped, never emitted with an empty list.
The kept rule requires the conjunction of both sides' conditions. Conditions are never merged, weakened, or reordered.
A family the bound keeps is forced to strict, so a bounded family never forwards an unpoliced tool.

fail_closed_rules: A condition operator outside condition_operators fails at compile time.
A verb repeated within one spec fails at compile time.
A family whose intersection leaves zero rules is dropped rather than left unpoliced.
An unknown, lossy, or indeterminate comparison drops the affected verb or family; it never widens.
normalization: Verbs, fields, and condition values are compared as exact byte strings. No case folding, Unicode folding, trimming, wildcard expansion, or hierarchy inference is applied.
Rule order within a spec is preserved so compilation is deterministic.
